request.state:
L01: The tenancy runs for twelve months from the date of the keys.
L02: Rent is due on the first working day of each month.
L03: A deposit of one month's rent is held by a third party.
L04: The third party is named in the schedule.
L05: The tenant may ask the third party for a statement at any time.
L06: Damage beyond fair wear is charged against the deposit.
L07: Fair wear is judged against the inventory taken on the first day.
L08: The inventory is signed by both sides.
L09: A disagreement goes to the third party's own adjudicator.
L10: The deposit is returned within ten working days of the final inspection.
L11: The final inspection happens after the keys come back.
L12: Either side may end the tenancy with two months' notice.

q1.instructions: Which line says when the tenancy deposit is returned?
